title: Can LLMs Simulate Novice Programmers' Misconceptions?
title_zh: 大型语言模型能否模拟新手程序员的误解？

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 13 LLMs on generating, solving, simulating, and diagnosing novice programming misconceptions on code-tracing problems. While frontier models reliably perform these tasks, small models ( ≤ \leq 14B) struggle with dynamic execution. Notably, code-tuned models fail during misconception simulation by reverting to correct execution. Finally, misconception diagnosis is significantly easier in True/False formats than in open-ended generation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在代码追踪问题上，对 13 种大型语言模型（LLM）在生成、解决、模拟和诊断新手编程误解方面的能力进行了评估。 尽管前沿模型能够可靠地完成这些任务，但小型模型（≤ 14B）在处理动态执行时却面临困难。 值得注意的是，经过代码微调的模型在模拟误解时会因回归到正确执行而失败。 最后，在“真/假”格式中诊断误解，比在开放式生成任务中要容易得多。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are gaining importance in CS education, not only as tools for AI assisted software engineering and code generation, but also as systems that assist instructors, such as autograders, or that provide feedback through code review assistants ( Kiesler et al., 2023 ; Azaiz et al., 2024 ) , TA-like chatbots ( Liu and M’Hiri, 2024 ) , and tutoring systems ( Phung et al., 2023 ) . Evaluations of LLMs for code generation emphasize whether they understand specifications, produce correct solutions, and find/fix errors. However, in education, rather than simply detecting and fixing errors, systems should be able to understand why novice programmers make mistakes in their code ( Kaczmarczyk et al., 2010 ) . Beginning programmers frequently have incorrect mental models of programs and program execution (the notional machine ( Sorva, 2013 ) ). Skilled instructors can diagnose such underlying misconceptions from student work. In this paper, we focus on code tracing tasks, where students need to mentally simulate execution of a program and predict the output (a common type of exam question). Incorrect predictions may be diagnostic of specific misconceptions. We study how well different LLMs simulate this process from four angles. RQ1: Can LLMs generate new diagnostic code tracing tasks that could be used in quizzes, exams and tutoring systems (given definitions of misconceptions)?; RQ2: Can LLMs solve simple code tracing tasks, common in a CS1 course?; RQ3: Can LLMs be prompted to solve code tracing tasks incorrectly in ways that simulate specific student misconceptions? (i.e. the student perspective)?; RQ4: Can LLMs identify student misconceptions from incorrect answers to code tracing tasks? (i.e. the instructor’s perspective)?
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在计算机科学教育中的重要性日益凸显，它们不仅是人工智能辅助软件工程和代码生成工具，也是能够协助教学人员的系统，例如自动评分器、通过代码审查助手提供反馈的智能体（Kiesler et al., 2023; Azaiz et al., 2024）、类似助教聊天机器人（Liu and M’Hiri, 2024）以及辅导系统（Phung et al., 2023）。 针对代码生成能力的LLM评估主要关注其是否能够理解规格说明、生成正确解决方案，以及能否发现或修复错误。 然而，在教育领域，系统不应仅仅局限于检测和修复错误，而应能够理解新手程序员在代码中犯错的原因（Kaczmarczyk et al., 2010）。 初学编程的学生常常对程序和程序执行过程存在错误的心理模型（即概念机（Sorva, 2013））。 经验丰富的教师能够从学生的作业中诊断出这类潜在的误解。 在本文中，我们聚焦于代码追踪任务，即学生需要在大脑中模拟程序的执行过程并预测输出结果（这是常见的考试题型之一）。 错误的预测可能反映出特定的误解。 我们从四个角度研究不同LLM在执行这一过程中的表现。 研究问题1：在给定误解定义的前提下，LLM能否生成可用于测验、考试和辅导系统的全新诊断性代码追踪任务？；研究问题2：LLM能否解决计算机科学入门课程中常见的简单代码追踪任务？；研究问题3：能否通过提示让LLM以模拟学生特定误解的方式错误地解决代码追踪任务？ （即从学生的视角）？；研究问题4：LLM能否根据代码追踪任务的错误答案识别出学生的误解？ （即从教师的视角）？

paragraphs.en: The idea that mistakes novices make in programming are not random, but caused by specific and systematic misconceptions, has a long history in CS education ( Soloway, 1986 ; Kaczmarczyk et al., 2010 ) . Much work has focused on assembling misconception catalogs ( Chiodini et al., 2021 ) , through close observation and interviews ( Boulay, 1986 ) or mining common errors from repositories of student code ( Altadmri and Brown, 2015 ) , including with LLMs ( Al-Hossami and Bunescu, 2026 ) . Recent work in STEM education has explored LLMs for misconception modeling. Sonkar et al. (2024) ; Zengaffinen et al. (2026) finetune models to enable them to model specific student misconceptions about algebra. Liu et al. (2025) find that LLM error patterns on math problems do not align with the errors students make. Parker and Zavala-Cerna (2026) use LLMs to aid instructors in identifying misconceptions in biomedical science. Scarlatos et al. (2026) use LLMs to simulate students to testing educational technology. We are the first to specifically investigate LLMs for misconception modeling in CS education, with implications for teaching and learning programming with generative AI.
paragraphs.zh: 关于新手在编程中犯的错误并非随机，而是由特定且系统性的误解所导致这一观点，在计算机科学教育领域已有悠久的历史（Soloway，1986；Kaczmarczyk 等，2010）。 大量研究致力于构建误解目录（Chiodini 等，2021），方法包括通过密切观察和访谈（Boulay，1986），或从学生代码库中挖掘常见错误（Altadmri 和 Brown，2015），其中也涉及使用大型语言模型（Al-Hossami 和 Bunescu，2026）。 近期 STEM 教育领域的研究已探索将大型语言模型用于误解建模。Sonkar 等 （2024）；Zengaffinen 等 （2026）对模型进行微调，使其能够模拟学生关于代数的特定误解。Liu 等 （2025）发现，大型语言模型在数学问题上的错误模式与学生的实际错误并不一致。 Parker 和 Zavala-Cerna（2026）利用大型语言模型帮助教师识别生物医学科学中的误解。Scarlatos 等 （2026）使用大型语言模型模拟学生，以测试教育技术。 我们是首个专门研究将大型语言模型用于计算机科学教育中误解建模的学者，这对使用生成式人工智能进行编程教学与学习具有启示意义。

paragraphs.en: ProgMiscon 1 1 1 https://progmiscon.org/ ( Chiodini et al., 2021 ) is a curated online repository of common misconceptions encountered by students. We downloaded labels and brief descriptions of the 30 available Python misconceptions. For each misconception, we prompted Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 model to generate two exam-style code tracing problems, one multiple-choice version with four total options and one True/False question, for a total of 60 questions (see example in figure 1 ), with additional manual review. One of the answer choices reflected the correct output, while one (the misconception answer ) corresponded to the specific misconception. Every MC question had one correct option and at least one misconception option, and true/false question had a wrong answer corresponding to the misconception. After manual vetting, four questions had to be revised to align better with the description of the misconception (RQ1). We then prompted 13 LLMs to complete the following tasks for each code tracing question: Exp. 1: Select a response from the provided candidate answers (RQ2); Exp. 2: Predict the output and a brief explanation, without access to candidate answers (RQ2). 2 2 2 Only 27 out of the 60 generated questions were solvable without access to the answer choices because the answer choices often contain part of the problem statement. ; Exp. 3: Select a response from the provided candidate answers under the pretense of suffering from the misconception (RQ3); Exp. 4: Given a question and misconception answer , diagnose the misconception (free form output) (RQ4); Exp. 5: Repeat Exp. 4, but select the misconception from a list of all 30 misconception definitions (RQ4). For Exp. 2 and 4, we matched the LLMs’ output against the reference answer or misconception definition, using Claude Fable 5 with human review.
paragraphs.zh: ProgMiscon 1 1 1 https://progmiscon.org/ (Chiodini et al., 2021) 是一个精心整理在线资源库，收录了学生常遇到的常见误解。 我们下载了现有的 30 个 Python 误解的标签和简要描述。 对于每个误解，我们提示 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 模型生成两道考试风格的代码追踪题：一道包含四个选项的单选题和一道判断题，总计 60 道题（参见图 1 中的示例），并进行了额外的人工审核。 其中一个答案选项反映了正确的输出，而另一个（误解答案）则对应特定的误解。 每道单选题都有一个正确选项和至少一个误解选项，而判断题的错误答案则对应该误解。 经过人工审查后，有四道题需要修改，以更好地与误解描述保持一致（RQ1）。 接着，我们提示 13 个 LLM 针对每道代码追踪题完成以下任务：实验 1：从提供的候选答案中选择一个响应（RQ2）；实验 2：预测输出并给出简要解释，且无法查看候选答案（RQ2）。2 2 2 在生成的 60 道题中，只有 27 道可以在不查看答案选项的情况下解决，因为答案选项通常包含部分问题陈述；实验 3：在假装受到该误解影响的前提下，从提供的候选答案中选择一个响应（RQ3）；实验 4：给定一道题和误解答案，诊断出对应的误解（自由形式输出）（RQ4）；实验 5：重复实验 4，但需从全部 30 个误解定义列表中选出该误解（RQ4）。 对于实验 2 和 4，我们使用 Claude Fable 5 并结合人工审查，将 LLM 的输出与参考答案或误解定义进行比对。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows results for Exp. 1 and 2. Large frontier models ( Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and GPT-5.6 ) solve the entire question bank with minimal mistakes on the open-ended questions. The 30b open-weight models are also competitive, with Qwen3 ’s 30 billion parameter non-coder variant returning a perfect score on MC/TF. 3 3 3 We used API/CLI access for Anthropic and OpenAI models, and deployed the open weight models, including OLMo 3 ( Olmo Team, 2025 ) , locally using Ollama ( Ollama, 2026 ) . Smaller models appear unable to model dynamic code execution at the same level as students. We did not find systematic differences between models fine-tuned on coding tasks and comparable non-coding models.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows results for Exp. 3., investigating if LLMs can internalize programming misconceptions. The Followed column shows the percentage of MC/TF questions for which the model selected the misconception answer , i.e. the answer we would expect a student suffering from the misconception would give. Larger models with higher reasoning depth ( Opus and GPT-5.6 Sol ), perform best. The Correct column shows the percentage of questions for which the model chose the expected answer ignoring the misconception. This was an issue for coder models, which have been trained on large amounts of correct code examples. The misconception description in the prompt is not sufficient to overcome their bias for correct code generation and debugging. Inspecting the reasoning chain for Qwen3-coder , we find that it interrupts the process midway and turns from assuming the misconception to attempting to just solve the question. Table 3 shows results of detecting the misconception from a question / answer pair, either asking for a free description (Exp. 4) or selecting from the list of all misconceptions (Exp. 5). Selecting from a list is somewhat easier and, as before, large reasoning models perform best. Detecting misconceptions from TF question seems easier across both modalities. The TF questions are designed to more concretely address one specific misconception, while MC questions are more open-ended and require more abstract reasoning to identify the misconception from a single response.

paragraphs.en: Overall, our results suggest that (RQ1) LLMs can reliably generate diagnostic code tracing problems from misconception definitions; (RQ2) Larger LLMs (30+B parameters) can reliably solve code tracing problems; (RQ3) Large LLMs can mimic student behavior when answering code tracing problems under specific misconceptions. Model size and reasoning abilities seem to be key for this task and coding oriented models appear to be overfitted to a correct (misconception free) understanding of code. Future work will investigate to what degree LLMs actually model the notional machine and dynamic code execution rather than just stochastically simulating behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明：（RQ1）大语言模型能够可靠地根据错误概念定义生成代码追踪问题；（RQ2）参数规模更大的大语言模型（300亿以上参数）能够可靠地解决代码追踪问题；（RQ3）在特定错误概念的影响下，大型语言模型能够模仿学生在回答代码追踪问题时的行为。 模型规模和推理能力似乎是这项任务的关键，而面向编程的模型似乎对代码的正确理解（即无错误概念的理解）存在过度拟合。 未来的研究将探讨大语言模型在多大程度上真正模拟了概念机器和动态代码执行，而非仅仅随机模拟其行为。

sents.en: Model size and reasoning abilities seem to be key for this task and coding oriented models appear to be overfitted to a correct (misconception free) understanding of code.

sents.en: Future work will investigate to what degree LLMs actually model the notional machine and dynamic code execution rather than just stochastically simulating behavior.
